page.overview:
What is Batto Batto no Mi, Model: Vampire?

The Batto Batto no Mi, Model: Vampire is a game-exclusive, Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that gives the user the ability to turn into a vampire. It was eaten by Patrick Redfield.

The Batto Batto no Mi, Model: Vampire resembles a small [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/tomato tomato]: a rounded purple fruit covered in the signature spiral patterns characteristic of Devil Fruits. Its top possesses a curled green stem resembling a tail, while the lower portion of the fruit gradually becomes dark red, giving the appearance of the fruit having been dipped in or filled with blood, in reference to the blood-drinking imagery traditionally associated with vampires. The fruit is small enough to be comfortably held within one hand.

The ability user can transform into a mythical vampire, developing numerous physical features traditionally associated with both vampires and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bat bats]. In Patrick Redfield's case, his ears become long and pointed, his canine teeth extend into prominent fangs, his fingernails become elongated claws, and portions of his face and limbs become covered in purple fur. His body additionally develops pronounced bat-like characteristics, including large wing structures which can be used both for flight and as weapons in close combat.

Redfield is primarily shown fighting in a humanoid vampiric form that retains his general human proportions while adding the aforementioned animalistic characteristics. Sources associated with the game describe the fruit as permitting both a complete vampire transformation and a Human-Beast Form; however, the game itself does not clearly demonstrate a separate, conventional full-bodied Beast Form comparable to the completely animal forms normally displayed by Zoan users. As such, whether Redfield's demonstrated vampiric appearance is specifically his Human-Beast Form, his Beast Form, or whether this particular Mythical Zoan simply possesses an unusually humanoid transformation remains unclear.
